title: Picker Structured Outputs via output_config.format JSON Schema
goal: Replace the picker's text-then-JSON-parse path with Anthropic structured outputs (output_config.format with a json_schema) so Claude is forced to produce a syntactically valid JSON action that matches the pick/level_up/stop/exec_plan discriminator. Eliminates the entire class of JSON parse failures observed on 2026-05-15.
scope: Modify api/app/services/assessment_loop.py _claude_select_next_action to add output_config={'format': {'type': 'json_schema', 'schema': ...}}. Define the schema for the 4 action shapes. For the exec_plan 'plan' field (which has freeform inner objects incompatible with strict additionalProperties: false), use a JSON-stringified pattern with a one-line system prompt note and a single client-side json.loads step.
generation_reason: On 2026-05-15 the picker produced an exec_plan with an unescaped quote inside reasoning at char 2533 - _tolerant_json_fix could not repair it, the loop hit candidate is None and stopped. This pattern recurred multiple times. Structured outputs is the canonical fix per Anthropic docs.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Schema + plumbing only. Do NOT change the system prompt body. Do NOT alter the hop loop, tool definitions, or evidence consumption.
constraints.schema_constraints: Anthropic strict mode requires additionalProperties: false on every object. For exec_plan.plan inner objects (params, data, capture, expect.body_contains) which have freeform keys/types, treat plan as a JSON-stringified string field with a 1-2 sentence system prompt directive and a client-side json.loads step.
constraints.compatibility: Tool use (memory + http_fetch) must continue to work. Structured outputs constrains FINAL text output, not tool_use intermediate hops.

success_criteria: Picker call includes output_config.format with the 4-action discriminated schema.
Schema validates pick / level_up / stop / exec_plan with correct required fields per action.
Plan field handled via stringified pattern with 1 client-side decode step.
Live test on Gruyere produces zero JSON parse failures across 20+ picker advances.
Existing _tolerant_json_fix retained as defensive layer but Path is deprecated for warning-log only.
AGENT_SYSTEM_MAP.md section 2 known-issues entry on JSON parse failures is removed.
must_not_touch: _AI_PICKER_SYSTEM_PROMPT body lines 1-200 (only the brief plan-stringification note is appended).

acceptance_criteria: 20 consecutive live picker advances on Gruyere succeed with no JSON parse failures.
exec_plan with nested plan body parses successfully end-to-end.
Prompt cache hit ratio remains within 5% of pre-change baseline (logged usage).

before_promotion: NEXT_TASK.md must contain this task as the single active task.

out_of_scope: Switching picker to a different Claude model.
